signals.name: Ben Thompson
signals.latest_title: Game Decompilation, Is This Legal?, A Well-Trodden Path
signals.summary: Argues that AI-driven game decompilation raises legal questions, but the bigger risk to gaming is new games and more personalization. Also wrote that Apple's walled-garden protections now feel like limits in the AI era, and the weekly roundup covered Meta's focus and what OpenAI is doing.
signals.connection: Fits the AI-driven shifts across Frontier Tech and Applied Tech. His Apple piece on platform control sits alongside the open-weight race and the DeepSeek raise.

signals.name: Packy McCormick
signals.summary: Weekly optimism roundup covering Starship Orbital, America.gov, the Matic Master Plan, Freckle and Heart Age.
signals.connection: Starship Orbital touches on frontier infrastructure and energy-hungry compute, which relates to the Google–Constellation power deal.

signals.name: Lenny Rachitsky
signals.latest_title: OpenAI's Head of ChatGPT: We're entering a new era of AI (again) | Tibo Sottiaux
signals.summary: Tibo Sottiaux says Dots is OpenAI's biggest bet and that agents will dominate internet traffic. Lenny also posted a demo of ChatGPT Sites from OpenAI DevDay, which turns Slack, Notion and calendar data into internal tools.
signals.connection: Agent-driven traffic and internal tooling point to rising compute demand, as in the Broadcom–Anthropic financing. They also point to shifts in knowledge work, which ties to Labor & Workforce.
